_doc: API-layer parity matrix. Every request/response feature of the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs we serve, on every route x stream mode (+ Responses background). engaged = a probe in tests/unit/test_api_parity_wire.py or a named route-level test exercises the cell; na = the spec says it does not apply (cited); partial/missing = a documented gap with a kind (unimplemented | divergent | untested), an impact and an owner. tests/unit/test_api_parity.py enforces it; a new request field, server tool or router module without a row fails CI.

duplicates.note: Parsing is shared (yunshu_engine/tool_call_streamer.py) but each router re-implements the event emission: chat tool_calls deltas (3 helpers + a multi-choice variant), Responses function_call items and argument deltas, Messages tool_use blocks with input_json_delta.
duplicates.unify: One ToolEventSink(dialect) fed by ToolCallStreamer that renders start / args-delta / done for the three dialects; routers only wire the sink.

duplicates.note: Two shared shape builders cover OpenAI and Responses, Messages builds its own usage and cache split inline, and _record_metrics is copy-pasted verbatim in chat, anthropic and completions.
duplicates.unify: usage_shapes.py owns all three dialect shapes (add anthropic_usage) from one UsageFacts(prompt, completion, cached, creation, reasoning); one record_usage() replaces the three _record_metrics.

duplicates.note: resolve_sampling picks defaults once, but every router (and each of its stream / non-stream / VLM branches) then spells out the same ~30 engine kwargs by hand; a new field must be added in ten places (this matrix's forwarding probes are what catches a miss).
duplicates.unify: A single SamplingParams.from_request(req, dialect) that returns the engine kwargs dict; routers call it once per branch.

duplicates.note: Two ~1,500-line loop drivers (Messages blocks, Responses items) around one runtime; the generate / detect call / run tool / append / continue skeleton, iteration limits, pause_turn / incomplete handling and per-round usage are written twice.
duplicates.unify: One ServerToolLoop(core) with a dialect adapter that only renders blocks / items and parses history; the loop, limits and usage live in runtime.py.

duplicates.note: error_envelope.py shapes errors per dialect, main.py re-maps HTTPException text into codes (string match on 'exceeds max context window'), and each streaming path emits its own terminal error event.
duplicates.unify: ErrorSpec(code, status, message) raised by routers and rendered by error_envelope for JSON, SSE and Responses events; no string matching in main.py.

duplicates.note: The guard is shared, but each router creates its own cancel_event, threads it through every branch (text, VLM, multi-choice, background) and tears it down; Responses fakes a Request for background.
duplicates.unify: A RequestScope context manager (cancel_event, disconnect guard, request id, metrics) entered once per request by a route decorator.

duplicates.note: Engine finish reasons are mapped per dialect in three places (chat / completions share one), and Messages re-derives the matched stop sequence from text.
duplicates.unify: The engine returns (finish_kind, matched_stop); one table maps finish_kind to each dialect's vocabulary.

duplicates.note: Text-level splitting (extract_thinking / ThinkingParser) and engine-state splitting (current_state) both exist; Messages, completions and chat each carry their own fallback and tag stripping, which is why a streamed delta can carry tag text (see the reasoning_output row).
duplicates.unify: The engine always labels reasoning pieces (state machine); one ReasoningSplitter used by every dialect, text parsing only for engines that cannot label.

duplicates.note: Three parsers of json_schema / json_object / grammar into the engine constraint spec, each with its own validation and error text.
duplicates.unify: schemas/structured_outputs.py exposes parse_constraint(dialect_fragment) -> ConstraintSpec; routers pass their fragment.

duplicates.note: Same rule (auto / none / required / named, parallel off) written three times after the call is parsed, plus the forced-choice prefill helper only chat owns.
duplicates.unify: enforce_tool_choice(calls, ToolChoice, parallel) in one module; dialect parsers normalize tool_choice into ToolChoice first.

duplicates.note: Each dialect converts its messages to the engine format (inherently dialect-specific), but image part normalization, tool-result flattening and file inlining are repeated inside each converter.
duplicates.unify: Dialect converters emit one neutral Message/Part list; image, file and tool-result handling happen once on that list.

duplicates.note: n > 1 is implemented separately for chat text, chat VLM and completions (per-choice seed, shared cancel, summed usage) and not at all for the other routes.
duplicates.unify: A fan-out helper above the engine call: run n requests with seed+index, share the cancel event, merge usage; routers only render choices.

duplicates.note: Chat has a text and a VLM implementation of both stream and non-stream; Messages has a batched and a legacy non-stream; Responses bridges VLM requests through the chat handler. Every feature has to be added to each branch.
duplicates.unify: Follows the engine path convergence (one runner): once text-only models run on the runner, the routers keep one generate / stream implementation per dialect.

duplicates.note: Chat completions and Responses keep finished objects in two separate stores with their own owner checks and eviction.
duplicates.unify: One ObjectStore(kind) with owner checks and TTL; the two routes differ only in the object shape.
